overview.headline: Constant speed cruise and distance as ground speed times time aloft

keyPoints.point: Aircraft maintains constant airspeed in level flight when net external force is absent with lift equal to weight and thrust equal to drag
keyPoints.quote: Since there is no net external force on the aircraft, the aircraft maintains a constant airspeed as described by Newton’s First Law of Motion.

keyPoints.point: General rate equation states rate times time equals amount for relating how much is produced over time
keyPoints.quote: The general rate equation is “rate times time equals amount”.

keyPoints.point: Distance flown equals ground speed times time aloft when cruising at constant ground speed
keyPoints.quote: the distance flown is equal to the ground speed times the time aloft.

keyPoints.point: Maximum distance aircraft can fly equals ground speed times maximum time set by fuel load after which drag slows aircraft and lift decreases
keyPoints.quote: The maximum distance that the aircraft can fly is then equal to the ground speed times the maximum time (tmax).

keyPoints.point: Combat radius is defined as half the one way range to reflect round trip missions without refueling in enemy territory
keyPoints.quote: The combat radius would be half of the range as specified here.

keyTerms.gloss: upward force that balances weight in level flight
keyTerms.quote: in which the lift is equal to the weight, and the thrust is equal to the drag.

keyTerms.gloss: forward force that balances drag to keep speed constant
keyTerms.quote: So, the lift, drag, thrust, and fuel consumption rate also continually change.

keyTerms.gloss: speed over ground used with time aloft to compute distance flown
keyTerms.quote: the distance flown is equal to the ground speed times the time aloft.

keyTerms.gloss: greatest distance covered at given ground speed before maximum time expires
keyTerms.quote: We call this distance the maximum range (R) of the aircraft.

keyTerms.gloss: range for one leg of a round trip taken as half of total range
keyTerms.quote: The combat radius would be half of the range as specified here.
